title: Custom Printing
description: From the app to your wall: the calendar builder today, custom prints coming soon.

blocks.heading: Custom Printing
blocks.subheading: The pipeline doesn't end at a screen.

blocks.body:
## Today: the calendar builder

Built into the app now: assign photos — yours or the portfolio's — to a cover, twelve months, and a back cover. Every slot stays editable, the project syncs across your devices, it displays on the Apple TV as a living calendar, and it exports as a **print-ready PDF** you can take to any print shop.

## Coming soon: custom prints

Direct print ordering is in the works — museum-quality prints of the Twilightscapes portfolio, and of *your own* work straight from the app: shoot it with the [night camera](/camera), finish it in the [Darkroom](/software), hang it on the [TV](/display), then hold it in your hands.

Watch [the posts](/posts) for the announcement — it will land there (and in the app) first.
